title: Earthquakes

source.name: Simple English Wikipedia — Earthquake
source.note: Đã rút gọn và đơn giản hoá nhẹ một số câu; thông tin theo bài gốc.

paras: An earthquake is when the Earth’s tectonic plates shake and move the Earth’s surface. Strong earthquakes damage buildings. The plates are always moving slowly. When they get stuck, tension builds up. Then an earthquake happens when the plates suddenly break free and start moving quickly.

The point under the ground where an earthquake starts is called the hypocenter. The epicenter is the point on the ground directly above it. People who study earthquakes are called seismologists. A seismometer detects the tremors of the earth and plots them on a seismograph.

The strength of an earthquake can be measured with the Richter scale. Charles Francis Richter invented it in 1935, and the scale goes from 0 to 10. No one can tell when an earthquake will happen, but we know where earthquakes are likely to happen, such as near fault lines. An earthquake under the ocean can create a huge wave called a tsunami.
Earthquakes are common in some parts of the world. The biggest earthquake zone is the Pacific belt, which circles the Pacific Ocean. It has the most active earthquakes and the most volcanoes.

questions.q: What happens when the plates suddenly break free?
questions.explain: Đoạn 1: “an earthquake happens when the plates suddenly break free and start moving quickly”.

options: The point on the ground above the hypocenter
The point where the plates meet the sea
The place where a seismologist works
The biggest building in a city
questions.explain: Đoạn 2: “The epicenter is the point on the ground directly above it.”

options: It stops the plates from moving
It predicts the date of an earthquake
It detects the tremors of the earth
questions.explain: Đoạn 2: “A seismometer detects the tremors of the earth”.

questions.q: What can an earthquake under the ocean create?
options: A new volcano on the sea floor
A strong wind across the ocean
A huge wave called a tsunami
questions.explain: Đoạn 3: “An earthquake under the ocean can create a huge wave called a tsunami.”

questions.q: Scientists can say exactly when an earthquake will happen.
questions.explain: Đoạn 3: “No one can tell when an earthquake will happen”.

questions.q: Charles Richter was born in the United States.
questions.explain: Bài chỉ nói Richter phát minh thang đo năm 1935; không nói ông sinh ở đâu.

vocab.def: a sudden shaking of the ground
a strong pull or pressure between two things
a small shaking of the ground
to find the size or strength of something
to make or think of something new
